notes.bank_free_box_miss: Pixel collar outside the 0.18 m padded a6 box projection.
notes.bank_free_reviewed_through: Reviewed a37-body LiDAR return beyond the full padded a6 box plus 0.25 m.
notes.projected_scene_return: Nearest projected camera-z of all LiDAR returns. This does not identify a free camera ray.
notes.prior_outside_overlap: Legacy replay count using native a6 alpha and its fixed action collar.
notes.volume: Archived cells and fixed lower are inherited model proxies. One ray may hit several cells.
notes.split: Heldout here means exclusion from new heuristic evidence. Frozen prior models and domains predate this split.
